entities.summary: "Bad Boys" is a 1987 song by the Jamaican reggae band Inner Circle, which gained high popularity in the United States after its re-release in 1993, peaking at number eight on the Billboard Hot 100 and number seven on the Top 40 Mainstream chart. It is the opening theme to the American documentary TV show Cops and the theme song of the 1995 American action comedy film Bad Boys, and is also featured in the film's sequels.
